text:
Type: square coffee table on casters with storage
Use: holding drinks, books and remotes, storage; living room, family room
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: black-brown wood-effect finish, tinted glass top panel, castor wheels
Colors: black-brown, smoky dark glass, grey wheels
Shape: low boxy square block, one drawer beside open compartments on every side, four swivel casters, bulky and solid
Feel: practical, sturdy, dark, tidy
Goes with: dark wood, grey or beige sofas, white walls; modern living rooms and compact apartments

product.name: BOKSEL
product.description: Veneered surface; gives the table a natural look and feel.
